parrafo.es: Hair & Earth Organic Salon and Headspa trae tratamientos ayurvedicos de cuero cabelludo, color organico y cuidado capilar holistico al centro de Sarasota. Cada servicio usa productos organicos y seguros en un espacio tranquilo e intencional.
parrafo.en: Hair & Earth Organic Salon and Headspa brings ayurvedic scalp treatments, organic color and holistic hair care to Downtown Sarasota. Every service uses safe, organic products in a calm, intentional space.

hero.imagen_alt: Color organico terminado, cabello liso y brillante en Hair & Earth Organic Salon

parrafo_1.es: Hair & Earth esta a cargo de Erinn Earth, maestra de yoga certificada con formacion avanzada en masaje y mas de 15 anos de experiencia en el area de Sarasota. Antes del cabello, trabajo como trabajadora social con un titulo en psicologia, y ese cuidado por las personas se nota en cada cita.
parrafo_1.en: Hair & Earth is owned and run by Erinn Earth, a certified yoga teacher with advanced massage training and 15+ years of experience in the Sarasota area. Before hair, she worked as a social worker with a psychology degree, and that care for people shows in every appointment.

parrafo_2.es: Cada color, corte y tratamiento de cuero cabelludo usa productos organicos y seguros, y el Ayurvedic Scalp Massage insignia suma respiracion consciente, aceite tibio y masaje de puntos de presion en cuero cabelludo, cuello, mandibula, rostro y orejas, ademas de terapia de luz roja y toallas de vapor caliente.
parrafo_2.en: Every color, cut and scalp treatment uses safe, organic products, and the signature Ayurvedic Scalp Massage adds intentional breathing, warm oil and pressure-point massage across the scalp, neck, jaw, face and ears, plus red light therapy and hot steam towels.

texto.en: Root-to-tip color with organic, gentle formulas that protect your hair while it transforms.

texto.es: Un corte completo con shampoo y blow dry, terminado con productos organicos de peinado.
texto.en: A full haircut with shampoo and blow dry, finished with organic styling products.
